# Load Before Continuing

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(vegan)
library(FSA)
```

## Loading Data

```{r data loading}
# these chunks of code load in our master spreadsheets for data analysis. kate will keep updating her installed .csv's as we collect more data, but this will allow us to keep code relatively clean and our files relatively clean as well!
inverts_master <- read.csv("invert_master_data.csv")

fish_master <- read.csv("fish_master_data.csv")

upc_master <- read.csv("upc_master_data.csv")

```

## Data Cleaning

```{r scrubby dubby dub in my tubby tubby tub}
# these lines ensure consistent naming conventions so that we don't get caught up in wordslop <3
inverts_master <- clean_names(inverts_master)

fish_master <- clean_names (fish_master) 

upc_master <- clean_names (upc_master)

```

```{r build mcabee data}
upc_mcabee <- upc_master |>

```




# Analysies

## Shannon Diversity

Shannon diversity will be calculated in two ways:

- **1) Diversity will be calculated as a total for each site to create a more precise estimate for the sites**

- **2) Diversity will be calculated for each transect to allow an ANOVA to be run on replicates**

Use the first index number to describe the sites individually and use the second index number to describe the relationships between different sites

### Fancy Shannon

```{r shannon setup}
# organizing the data into total observations per species to run Shannon Index off of

# Monterey Bay

# fish
tot_fish_mcabee <- fish_mcabee |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
tot_invert_mcabee <- inverts_mcabee |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# Morro Bay

# fish
tot_fish_morro <- fish_morro |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
tot_invert_morro <- inverts_morro |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# Leo Carrillo

# fish
tot_fish_leo <- fish_leo |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
tot_invert_leo <- inverts_leo |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# La Jolla

# fish
tot_fish_jolla <- fish_jolla |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
tot_invert_jolla <- inverts_jolla |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# names have been preemptively entered into the data, so check for conflicting names if any errors occur
```

```{r shannon knock them down}
# shannon diversity calculations and table output

# Monterey Bay

# fish
mont_f <- diversity(tot_fish_mcabee$total_count)

# invert
mont_i <- diversity(tot_invert_mcabee$total_count)

# Morro Bay

# fish
morr_f <- diversity(tot_fish_morro$total_count)

# invert
morr_i <- diversity(tot_invert_morro$total_count)

# Leo Carrillo

# fish
leo_f <- diversity(tot_fish_leo$total_count)

# invert
leo_i <- diversity(tot_invert_leo$total_count)

# La Jolla

# fish
joll_f <- diversity(tot_fish_jolla$total_count)

# invert
joll_i <-diversity(tot_invert_jolla$total_count)


# fish diversity index df creation
list("site" = c("Monterey Bay", "Morro Bay", "Leo Carrillo", "La Jolla"), 
     "index"= c(mont_f, morr_f, leo_f, joll_f)) |>
  as.data.frame()

# invert diversity index df creation
list("site" = c("Monterey Bay", "Morro Bay", "Leo Carrillo", "La Jolla"), 
     "index"= c(mont_i, morr_i, leo_i, joll_i)) |>
  as.data.frame()

# again, names could be a potential issue for running code in this chunk
```

### Shannon ANOVA

```{r shannon data control}
# diversity df creation

# fish
group_fish <- fish_master |>
  uncount(count) |>
  group_by(site_location, transect_num, species) |>
  count()

# invert
group_invert <- inverts_master |>
  uncount(count) |>
  group_by(location, transect_num, species) |>
  count()

```

```{r}
# shannon index calculation per transect

# fish
h_fish <- group_fish |>
  group_by(site_location, transect_num) |>
  mutate(tn = sum(n),
         pi = n/tn,
         lnpi = log(pi),
         "pi*lnpi" = pi * lnpi,
         h = -sum(pi*lnpi))

h_fish <- h_fish|>
  group_by(site_location, transect_num, h) |>
  summarize()

# invert
h_invert <- group_invert |>
  group_by(location, transect_num) |>
  mutate(tn = sum(n),
         pi = n/tn,
         lnpi = log(pi),
         "pi*lnpi" = pi * lnpi,
         h = -sum(pi*lnpi))

h_invert <- h_invert|>
  group_by(location, transect_num, h) |>
  summarize()

```

```{r diversity conditions}

# normality

# fish
h_fish |> 
  group_by(site_location) |>
  do(broom::tidy(shapiro.test(.$h))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(site_location, W = statistic, "p-value" = p.value)

# invert
h_invert |>
  group_by(location) |>
  do(broom::tidy(shapiro.test(.$h))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(location, W = statistic, "p-value" = p.value)


# homogeneity of residuals

# fish
bartlett.test(h ~ site_location, data = h_fish)

# invert
bartlett.test(h ~ location, data = h_invert)

```

```{r diversity ANOVA}
# which analysis is ran depends on if the data passes the condition tests (delete tests that we will not use, this will not be determined until all data is entered)

# all p >= 0.05, use `aov()`

# any p < 0.05, use `kruskal.test`


# if something shows up in ANOVA tests

# use a Tukey or Dunn post HOC test



# fish
h_fih_aov <- lm(h ~ site_location, data = h_fish)
aov(h_fih_aov)

kruskal.test(h ~ site_location, data = h_fish)

TukeyHSD(aov(h_fih_aov))

dunnTest(h ~ site_location, data = h_fish, method = "bonferroni")

# invert
h_inv_aov <- lm(h ~ location, data = h_invert)
aov(h_inv_aov)

kruskal.test(h ~ location, data = h_invert)

TukeyHSD(aov(h_inv_aov))

dunnTest(h ~ location, data = h_invert, method = "bonferroni")

```


## Density Stuff

```{r density data wrangle}
# calculating densities based off of number of 30m transects deployed

# fish transects will be linear density (1/m)

# invert transects will be area density (1/m^2)

# Monterey: 16 fish (30 x 16 = 480 m), 5 invert (30 x 2 x 5 = 300 m^2)

den_mont_fish <- tot_fish_mcabee |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/480) |>
  mutate("site" = "Monterey Bay")

den_mont_invert <- tot_invert_mcabee |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/300) |>
  mutate("site" = "Monterey Bay")


# Morro Bay: 8 fish (30 x 8 = 240 m), 8 invert (30 x 2 x 8 = 480 m^2)

den_morr_fish <- tot_fish_morro |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/240) |>
  mutate("site" = "Morro Bay")

den_morr_invert <- tot_invert_morro |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/480) |>
  mutate("site" = "Morro Bay")

# Leo Carrillo:

den_leo_fish <- tot_fish_leo |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/1) |> # add density here
  mutate("site" = "Leo Carrillo")

den_leo_invert <- tot_invert_leo |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/1) |> # add density here
  mutate("site" = "Leo Carrillo")

# La Jolla:

den_jolla_fish <- tot_fish_jolla |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/1) |> # add density here
  mutate("site" = "La Jolla")

den_jolla_invert <- tot_invert_jolla |>
  mutate("density" = total_count/1) |> # add density here
  mutate("site" = "La Jolla")

```

```{r assumptions}

# combining fish densities from all sites
binded_density_fish <- bind_rows(den_mont_fish, den_morr_fish, den_leo_fish, den_jolla_fish) 
# need to add other densities to here for assumption tests

# combining invert densities from all sites
binded_density_invert <- bind_rows(den_mont_invert, den_morr_invert, den_leo_invert, den_jolla_invert)
# need to add other densities to here for assumption tests


# assumption of normality (p < 0.05 means that we fail assumption)

# fish
binded_density_fish|> 
  group_by(site)|>
  do(broom::tidy(shapiro.test(.$density))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(site, W = statistic, 'pvalue' = p.value)

# invert
binded_density_invert|> 
  group_by(site)|>
  do(broom::tidy(shapiro.test(.$density))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(site, W = statistic, 'pvalue' = p.value)


# homogeneity of variances (p < 0.05 means that we fail assumption)

# fish
bartlett.test(density ~ site, data = binded_density_fish)


# invert
bartlett.test(density ~ site, data = binded_density_invert)
```

```{r density ANOVA}
# probably will be all using non-parametric tests since the data funky, so we usin' kruskal

# fish
kruskal.test(density ~ site, data = binded_density_fish)

dunnTest(density ~ site, data = binded_density_fish, method = "bonferroni")

# invert
kruskal.test(density ~ site, data = binded_density_invert)

dunnTest(density ~ site, data = binded_density_invert, method = "bonferroni")
```


# Visuals

```{r ocean's visual 1}
mcabee_density <- inverts_mcabee %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(density = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE) / 100)

ggplot(mcabee_density,
       aes(x = reorder(species, -density), y = density,
       fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
labs(title = "Density of McAbee Invertebrate Species 2026",
    x = "Species", y = "Density per Meter Squared") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

```{r}
## Invertebrate richness by site
invert_richness <- inverts_master |>
  filter(
    !is.na(location),
    !is.na(species),
    !is.na(total_count),
    total_count > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(
    richness = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    site_label = str_to_title(str_replace_all(location, "_", " "))
  )

ggplot(
  invert_richness,
  aes(x = reorder(site_label, richness), y = richness, fill = site_label)
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Invertebrate Species Richness by Site",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Total Species Richness"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
